card.headline: Did you know there are better words than *"very surprised"*?

beats.speech: Did you know there are better words than very surprised? Here are three.
Astonished: She opens the box. She is astonished.
Amazed: She sees the gift. She is amazed.
Stunned: She hears the news. She is stunned.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!

language_approval.notes: All 5 beats natural B1, no very in examples. astonished (opening a box), amazed (seeing a gift), stunned (hearing news) are correct very-surprised synonyms in correct senses; hook/CTA identical to approved siblings. No wording changes; footage fields untouched; caps OK; no policy issues (stock footage of a woman, neutral reactions).
